description: This file contains shell script code primarily used for testing git hook behavior, including setting up hooks, pushing to remote repositories, and verifying output. It includes definitions of test scenarios involving 'proc-receive' hooks and their responses to push attempts.

methods.name: test_hook
methods.description: Sets up a test hook with specified parameters, used to simulate hook behavior during tests.

methods.name: test-tool proc-receive
methods.description: Simulates the 'proc-receive' process by outputting specified responses for hook testing.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a successful test scenario with a descriptive label.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail, used to verify negative cases.

methods.name: make_user_friendly_and_stable_output
methods.description: Converts raw output into a stable, user-friendly format for comparison.

methods.name: format_and_save_expect
methods.description: Formats expected output for comparison in tests.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares actual output to expected output.

methods.name: test_cmp_refs
methods.description: Compares references of the repository to expected references.
